name: Spambase Email Classification Benchmark
description: The Spambase dataset consists of 4,601 email messages characterized by 57 continuous real-valued features reflecting word frequencies (such as 'make', 'address', 'free'), character frequencies, and run-length statistics of capital letters. It serves as a benchmark for binary spam classification.
